To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
community integration in mental healthcare can be understood as community integration work in interaction.
community integration is not only service user's individual challenge but also our challenge, and that it is accomplished in interaction.

community integration work in mental health FSSs is a social activity in which practitioners and service users together make decisions about how to promote community integration in each individual case, and that community integration is accomplished through discursive devices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how we, together with service users, can develop community integration work in mental health practices.
how community integration work can be developed in mental health services and how it can be better integrated with other social services.
the social construction of the concept and practices of community integration.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
community integration is a process of interaction in which service users and practitioners, together or separately, make decisions about the service user's everyday life.
community integration is an ongoing process, a work in progress, which is accomplished by service user-practitioners through interaction.
community integration is an interactional achievement.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

community integration work in mental health FSSs is not about the individual but the interaction between service users and practitioners, and the interaction between service user and practitioner and the community.
community integration work in mental health is about the interaction between practitioners and service users and about their mutual efforts to make the community work.
we need to develop a better understanding of how to make the community a better place for all of us.
The main takeaway from our work is that
community integration work in practice is a matter of social interaction and social relations.
community integration work in mental health FSSs is about interaction and, thus, it is not a technical or managerial issue but an ethical and moral one.
the idea of integration should be understood and tackled in the context of service user-practitioners' everyday work.
